name: Internet Plus
summary: Sydney dialup/dedicated + hosting ISP (a division of Zircon Systems Pty Ltd, ip.net.au; POPs Syd/Melb/Bris/Adel/Perth); went to PSINet (1999) as part of Zircon, then NTG (2002), then Nexon (2003-04) (ACN 003 233 421).

events.details: Internet Plus, division of Zircon Systems (Mascot).

refs.label: Published 26 Oct 1999; Internet Plus (ip.net.au) was a division of Zircon Systems.
The ip.net.au domain continued to serve a Zircon page to 2005, but the ISP had already changed ownership in 1999.
